svg.title: Automation: a terminal and the keyboard typing into it
svg.desc: A terminal window above a 3D 75% mechanical keyboard with per-key RGB. Key by key, the keyboard types this repo's pipeline into the terminal: node scripts/gen-profile.mjs lists generated files with their sizes (hero-banner.svg 27.5 kB, keyboard.svg 25.2 kB, stack-server.svg 31.2 kB), 26 SVG files from one set of design tokens; node --test scripts/*.test.mjs passes; git push origin main hands over to GitHub Actions, which keeps the numbers current. A rainbow wave runs through the keys, the plate, the light bar and the terminal's edge together.

g.text: 26 svg files from one set of design tokens
GitHub Actions keeps the numbers current
